say:4:1423475003:1.text: You actually found them all? I don't know how to thank you!
say:4:1423475003:1.source_cn: 啊，这这这！这怎么好意思！

say:5:1423475004:1.text: It started as a fun idea—if someone visited all the Helthor statues, they'd stumble upon a little surprise I tucked away...
say:5:1423475004:1.source_cn: 其实这只是我一时兴起的想法，如果有矮人对赫托老爷子的雕...

say:6:1423475005:1.text: But then I figured it was too much to ask. Who'd really bother visiting them all? The gift would stay hidden forever!

say:7:1423475006:1.text: Even I got lost in the woods trying to find them. Expecting someone else to do it felt pretty unfair...

say:9:1423475007:1.text: Chippy thinks so too. If one person can do it, more will follow. So don't stress about it!

say:12:1423475009:1.text: You know, those travel booklets are everywhere now. They walk people through the trickiest spots step by step.

say:15:1423475012:1.text: Thanks to you, I can finally make it happen. Really appreciate the help!
